article.title: Israel has cut off water to 47 Palestinian families in the northern West Bank
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: Since Israel severed the water lines feeding Ras al-Ahmar over a month ago, its 47 farming families have been rationing what little they have and weighing whether to sell their livestock and leave.
